cells.gaps: No credible statistic found since October 2023 gives graduate unemployment of 14 per cent or less.
cells.note: Restaged 2026-11-09 on Bill's ruling (message 94): question 4 asks for graduate unemployment from any credible statistic, not youth unemployment. The latest figure, 2.19 per cent of employment for 2025, clears 1; the World Bank's around 9 per cent counts all young people, not graduates, so it stays at 4.
